scenes.say: It works on my machine. The most famous excuse in software.
scenes.title: It works on my machine

scenes.say: Your laptop has one setup. The server has another, so the app breaks.
Docker fixes this. You describe your app's world in one small file.
Docker builds it into an image, then runs that image as a container, the same everywhere.
Need more power? Start ten copies in seconds, then shut them down.
scenes.label: requests per second

scenes.say: Every major cloud runs it: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and Kubernetes.
Docker Hub serves billions of image downloads every month.
scenes.label: image pulls per month on Docker Hub

scenes.say: That's Docker. Ship the whole machine, not just the code.
scenes.title: Ship the whole machine
